title: New Teen Titans Annual #2 DC August 1986 Origin of Brother Blood John Byrne
condition_description: Spine wear with a small chipped area near the top left of the front, toning and a light stain on the back cover top edge. See photos.
description:
The New Teen Titans Annual #2 (DC Comics, August 1986), origin of Brother Blood. Written by Marv Wolfman, art by John Byrne, Jose Luis Garcia-Lopez and Jim Baikie; cover by John Byrne. Baxter format, $2.50 cover price.

Back cover: Teen Titans Spotlight house ad.

Condition: spine wear with a small worn area near the top left of the front cover, toning and a light stain along the top edge of the back cover (see close-up).

Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
